author: Russell Brand
description:
Laura opens up about the emotional toll of the media storm surrounding Russell Brand, revealing how difficult things have been behind the headlines. She shares how prayer, reading Psalms, and God's grace are helping her stay grounded, while Russell reflects on media bias, personal suffering, and why surrendering to Jesus Christ offers a path toward peace, grace, and love.
